summary: Aquestive Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Credit Agreement with Oaktree Capital Management for a five-year term loan facility of up to $150 million, consisting of multiple tranches. The initial $55 million Tranche A Term Loan was funded on May 12, 2026, and used to repay existing debt; remaining proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Additional tranches are contingent on FDA approval for Anaphylm or net sales milestones. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is involved; this is a routine financing arrangement.
